benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Buy 1 Ticket and Get Upto Rs 500 Off on the 2nd Ticket.|Spend ₹25,000 in the preceding calendar quarter to unlock the quota for the current quarter.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
benefitRows.exclusion: Can be availed 2 times in a month and price of second ticket should be less then ₹500.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Get round-the-clock concierge assistance by calling the toll-free number 18002670731
benefitRows.howToAvail: Contact i-Assist, 24x7 concierge service at 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable).
